# Overview

This is a non-self-contained mock report pulled from the SQLite database.

- Rendered: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")`
- Database: `r params$db_path`
- Window: last `r params$days_back` days

## Zentracloud

```{r, echo = F}

# Reference the table without loading it yet
remote_table <- tbl(con, "zentracloud_data")
start_time <- as.numeric(as.POSIXct(
  paste(Sys.Date() - params$days_back, "00:00:00"),
  tz = "UTC"
))
# Filter and select a portion of data in the Zentra Cloud table within the sql
df_subset <- remote_table %>%
  filter(date >= !!start_time) %>%
  collect()
```


```{r}
#converting dates in df from unix timestamp to readable date-time objects
df_subset <- df_subset %>%
  mutate(date = as_datetime(date))

#######
# 1. Define your stations
stations_to_pull <- c("z6-28071", " z6-28073", "z6-32392", "z6-32393", "z6-32483") 

site_names <- c(
  "z6-28071" = "Langhor",
  "z6-28073" = "Hebgen",
  "z6-32392" = "W. Bridger Cr",
  "z6-32393" = "Whitetail",
  "z6-32483" = "Bear Palmer")

# 2. Define the summary function
get_site_summary <- function(id) {
  
  # Filter data for this specific site
  site_data <- df_subset %>% filter(station_id == id)
  
  if(nrow(site_data) == 0) return(NULL) # Skip if ID doesn't exist
  
  latest_date <- max(site_data$date, na.rm = TRUE)
  cutoff_date <- latest_date - days(14)
  
  # Latest values
  current <- site_data %>% filter(date == latest_date) %>% head(1)
  
  # 14-day-ago values
  old <- site_data %>% filter(date >= cutoff_date) %>% arrange(date) %>% head(1)
  
  # Combine into a single row
  tibble(
    Site = ifelse(id %in% names(site_names), site_names[id], id),
    `4" SM %` = current$port_2_teros_11_percent_water_content,
    `4", 14-Day SM Change` = current$port_2_teros_11_percent_water_content - old$port_2_teros_11_percent_water_content,
    `8" SM %` = current$port_3_teros_11_percent_water_content,
    `8", 14-Day SM Change` = current$port_3_teros_11_percent_water_content - old$port_3_teros_11_percent_water_content
  )
}

# 3. Run for all sites and stack rows
final_table <- map_df(stations_to_pull, get_site_summary)

############add acumulated precip

precip_summary <- df_subset %>%
  group_by(station_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_precip = sum(
        port_1_atmos_41_in_precipitation, 
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

precip_summary <- precip_summary %>%
  mutate(Site = site_names[station_id])
```


```{r}
# Join to your main table
final_table <- final_table %>%
  left_join(
    precip_summary %>% select(Site, total_precip), 
    by = "Site"
  )

final_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "April 7, 2024: CGNF Soil Moisture Summary") %>%
  
  # Clean up the long precip column name for the table header
  cols_label(total_precip = "14-Day Precip (in)") %>%
  
  # --- COLOR LOGIC ---
  data_color(
    columns = c(`4", 14-Day SM Change`, `8", 14-Day SM Change`),
    fn = function(x) ifelse(x < 0, "red", "darkgreen"),
    apply_to = "text"
  ) %>%
  
  # Style the new Precip column
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "blue", weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = total_precip)
  ) %>%
  
  # Bold the SM Change columns
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = c(`4", 14-Day SM Change`, `8", 14-Day SM Change`))
  ) %>%
  
  fmt_number(columns = -Site, decimals = 2) %>%
  cols_width(Site ~ px(150), everything() ~ px(100)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Site) %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 6, color = "gray")



```
